description: Hosted CI runs the whole-product browser sweep (scripts/uat/browser_workflow_smoke.mjs) as parallel shards, one CI job each, selected with EUROGAS_UAT_SHARD. Every workspace (swept in EN/ZH at the three viewports) and every later stage belongs to exactly one shard; the sweep refuses this file otherwise, and tests/contract/test_browser_shards.py holds the ci.yml matrix to these names. Balanced by measured sweep time (docs/engineering/CI_AND_BRANCH_PROTECTION.md).
